verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises 'Fibi AI agent' that can automatically resolve customer issues and provide instant AI answers, which constitutes a built-in AI assistant that can be delegated support tasks. However, evidence is limited to marketing taglines with no detail on task delegation scope, configuration, or hands-on validation. Missing for 10: technical docs on delegating specific tasks to Fibi, independent/hands-on verification of its autonomy, and detail on scope of tasks it can handle beyond support tickets.
